thesis: A light-lavender back-of-house recruiting console — a hiring team's pipeline 'at a glance'. The Fancy kit worn as a people-ops screen: a slim white topbar with a Pipeline / Roles / Calendar switcher over a full-bleed, board-first work area, closed by a pinned 4-KPI strip. The hero is a horizontal Kanban of five funnel stages whose candidate cards drag between stages (the totals follow), each card an initials avatar + a 5-segment fit-score meter + a mono time-in-stage stamp. One violet accent on near-white, medium-high density, mono numerics — a screen a recruiter actually runs a req from.

tokens.accent: #7C3AED violet-600 (with #8B5CF6 violet-500) · gradient 'R' mark #5B21B6→#A78BFA · stage ramp #8A7FA0→#8B5CF6→#7C3AED→#5B21B6→#0F9D58 (muted→violet→green Hired) · #0F9D58 positive-delta green
tokens.fontMono: Geist Mono (var(--font-mono)) — meta count, stage-count pills, card age stamps, table candidate counts, KPI deltas
tokens.radius: 12px candidate cards + Table + status chips (999px pills) · 9px tab track / 6px active pill · avatars 50% · 999px stage-count + score chips
tokens.border: 1px #ECE7F4 hairline on every panel/card/topbar; #F1EDF8 softer table-row + KPI dividers; score-meter track #E7DEF5
tokens.motion: Restrained: a 1.8s opacity/glow pulse on the live topbar dot; a 140ms card-lift + border-tint on candidate-card hover; a 180ms tab-switch ease; ECharts' own sparkline mount. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

layout: Full-viewport, board-first workspace that fills the frame (height: calc(100dvh - 52px), overflow hidden). A 52px white Navbar topbar (gradient 'R' mark + Roster/Recruiting wordmark linking to the gallery index, a 3-way segmented Tabs switcher Pipeline/Roles/Calendar, and a right-aligned mono meta count with a live dot) sits above a flex work area. Pipeline is a horizontally-scrolling Kanban of five 250px stage lanes (14px gutters, 18px pad); each lane is a sticky header (label + gradient-ramp count pill) over an independently-scrolling 9px-gapped candidate-card stack. Roles swaps in a centred open-reqs Table with a Pillbox team filter; Calendar swaps in an upcoming-interviews Timeline. A pinned bottom KPI strip closes the frame: 4 borderless Cards split by vertical Separators, each an eyebrow label + big value + colored delta + violet trend sparkline.

sections.name: Topbar
sections.what: 52px white bar: a gradient 'R' logo tile + 'Roster / Recruiting' wordmark linking back to the gallery index; a segmented pill switcher of three views (Pipeline active, Roles, Calendar) wired to real state (the mock's tabs were visually active but static); a right-aligned live dot + mono status '18 open roles · 42 candidates'.
sections.restyle: react-fancy <Navbar> flattened to a 52px hairline-bottom strip; the pills <Tabs.List variant=pills> re-skinned via [data-react-fancy-tabs-tab][aria-selected] to a #F1ECFB track with a white/#7C3AED active pill; the meta is a <Badge> stripped to transparent mono muted text beside a CSS-pulsed dot.

sections.name: Pipeline board
sections.what: The hero: a horizontal Kanban of five recruiting stages (Applied 42, Screening 24, Interview 14, Offer 6, Hired 3). Each 250px lane header pairs a bold stage label with a count pill whose fill deepens along the stage-progress ramp; candidate cards drag between stages and the stage totals follow the move (Human+ controlled board state an agent could drive).
sections.restyle: react-fancy <Kanban> as the board (data-react-fancy-kanban → flex row, 14px gap, 18px pad, x-scroll); each unstyled <Kanban.Column> becomes a 250px lane whose auto cards-container scrolls under a sticky header; the count <Badge> gets its background inline from the STAGE_RAMP indexed by stage order.

sections.name: Candidate card
sections.what: Per-candidate tile inside a stage lane: a circular initials avatar in the person's brand colour, name + role (ellipsised), a 5-segment fit-score meter (filled violet up to the 1–5 score, remainder pale lilac), and a mono time-in-stage stamp (today / 1d / 2d / Jul 1).
sections.restyle: unstyled <Kanban.Card> → white 12px tile with a hover lift; <Avatar fallback> forced to 32px with a per-person background from a --dbroster-avbg custom prop + white initials; the score is five restyled <Progress size=sm> bars (track #E7DEF5, fill #7C3AED, width 100/0 per segment) — the review's segmented rating meter as a real Fancy primitive rather than the mock's post-render paint() DOM mutation.

sections.name: Roles view
sections.what: The Roles tab: a centred snapshot of open requisitions (role, team, stage, candidate count, status) with a Pillbox team filter and a '+ New role' button. Status chips read Open (violet) / Hot (amber) / Closing (green); the count column is mono.
sections.restyle: a restyled <Table> (data-react-fancy-table → 12px card, uppercase muted column heads on a lilac wash, #F1EDF8 row dividers, hover tint); <Pillbox> as a compact violet-bordered filter that actually narrows the rows; a ghost <Button>; status <Badge>s coloured inline from a STATUS_COLOR map.

sections.name: Calendar view
sections.what: The Calendar tab: this week's five scheduled interviews as a vertical feed (onsite loops, system-design rounds, an offer call, an EM panel), each with a date/time, title, and one-line context; offer events read green, interviews violet.
sections.restyle: a data-driven <Timeline events=[...] animated=false> inside a white 14px panel; dot colours come from each event's color (violet / green) so the feed keys to the same palette as the board.

sections.name: KPI strip
sections.what: Pinned bottom row of four metrics, each an uppercase eyebrow, a large value, a colored delta, and a violet trend sparkline: Time to hire 24d (▼3d, green), Offer accept 82% (▲5%, green), Pipeline value 42 (active, muted), Cost / hire $4.2k (▼$300, green).

contentArchetype: A single-snapshot people-ops dashboard: one hiring team's live recruiting pipeline for a fictional company. Real back-office data — a five-stage funnel with per-candidate cards (initials, role, 1–5 fit score, time-in-stage), a table of open requisitions by team and status, this week's scheduled interviews, and four hiring KPIs (time to hire, offer-accept rate, pipeline value, cost per hire) with trend deltas. Everything is one moment in time — the screen a recruiter glances at between interviews, and drags a candidate across when they advance.
remix: Swap the violet-on-lavender palette for any single-accent-on-light scheme and this becomes a generic pipeline console: the Kanban stages generalise to any funnel (sales deals, support tickets, content review, applications) by renaming the columns and recolouring the stage ramp; the 5-segment Progress meter becomes any 1–5 rating (lead score, priority, confidence); the KPI strip re-labels to any four metrics with sparkline trends. Keep the Tabs switcher to fan a board out into board / table / timeline views of the same data, or drop the Calendar tab and widen the board for a pure kanban. Blend with a dark ops-console blueprint (e.g. griddle) for a night-shift theme.
